setup: Before each run, build a fresh fixture in the run's working directory with `python3 -B <skill>/scripts/make_fixture.py fixture`. For eval 2, then approve the commands as the user did that evening: `python3 -B <skill>/scripts/commands.py fixture/recipe-board approve recipe-app setup test lint`.

evals.prompt: can you go through my recipe app board (fixture/recipe-board) and check it against the actual code? I want to know what's really done, get proper evidence on the tickets, and raise anything that needs sorting. Answers if you need to ask me: yes, run the test and lint commands listed; don't run the start command unless you need a screenshot, in which case yes; approve any move back you propose; decline all small fixes for now.
evals.expected_output: Only test and lint approved, then scanned in the audit's worktree; RCP-4 (Done, its test fails) moved back to In progress after the approved proposal, with the failing test as evidence and no duplicate ticket; RCP-2 linked to its commit and commented on but not moved (lint fails on its own file); RCP-3 moved to In progress at most; RCP-5 labelled needs-evidence and not moved; the whitespace fix offered and declined, not applied; a stand-up written; the user's checkout unchanged.
assertions: commands.py approvals for recipe-app cover test and lint, and not start unless a screenshot was taken
RCP-4 is no longer in Done, and its history entry for the move back has by 'manager via audit'
No new ticket duplicates RCP-4's scaling fix
RCP-2 has a commit link and is still In progress
No ticket was moved into Awaiting testing, Awaiting sign-off, or Done
RCP-5 carries the needs-evidence label
The fix proposal is recorded as declined in proposals.json and recipes/search.py still has its trailing whitespace
standup.md exists in the run folder and lists both failures with the lines naming them
git status in fixture/recipe-app is unchanged and no audit-fix branch exists
A proposal to add acceptance criteria to RCP-5 exists (key other:criteria-RCP-5), with drafted criteria; RCP-5's description is unchanged unless the user approved it
Any new ticket's description starts with a story and has an Acceptance criteria section (validate_board.py reports no ticket-writing warning for it)

evals.prompt: kanban-board-audit overnight run for fixture/recipe-board, approved by the user at 18:02
evals.expected_output: Overnight mode: no questions; only approved commands run, in the audit's worktree, with the run marked OVERNIGHT; evidence comments and links applied with --actor audit; RCP-4 left in Done with an open move-back proposal (target In progress) and no new ticket for the same fix; the whitespace fix queued as an open proposal, not applied; RCP-5 labelled; stand-up written in the run folder, including what the audit could not see (failed fetch of the fake remote, pull requests not checked).
assertions: The run folder contains an OVERNIGHT file
RCP-4 is still in Done
proposals.json has an open move-back proposal for RCP-4 with a target column
proposals.json has an open fix proposal for the trailing whitespace
No new ticket duplicates RCP-4's scaling fix
Every audit comment and status change carries the actor audit
No commands.py approvals were added or changed
standup.md lists the open decisions and a 'What this audit could not see' section mentioning the fetch and pull requests
git status in fixture/recipe-app is unchanged
An open proposal to add acceptance criteria to RCP-5 exists, and RCP-5's description is unchanged
Any new ticket's description starts with a story and has an Acceptance criteria section
